687-5004-8249--73.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, milling three cards and returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4279-7286-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-7286-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-2466-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2760-4153.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2760-4153.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Nest of Scarabs and Resourceful Defense.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
2760-4153.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

1379-2685-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-4017-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

792-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1090-4605-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Restoration Angel.
Restoration Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Restoration Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

7-147-7300.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-147-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7154.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5282-6558-7149.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Naga Fleshcrafter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Naga Fleshcrafter dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Naga Fleshcrafter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

625-1978-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
625-1978-5711.description:
Cause Fanatic of Rhonas to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat from step 2.

972-2792-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2792-4477.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa and the Great Whale token.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2792-4477.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Greenwarden of Murasa instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

2173-2403-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1580-2279-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4364-4636-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aurelia that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the oldest Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aurelia token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Aurelia token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1171-4359.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-4359.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

222-2018-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2316-4871-5334.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4871-5334.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

659-2079-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-2079-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

678-4050-4275-5545.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Angels that have flying.
678-4050-4275-5545.description:
Cast Sephara by paying {W} and tapping four Angels with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sephara, adding {W}.
When Sephara dies, Enduring Renewal and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Sephara from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Angels.
Repeat.

215-851-4050-4729-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-851-4050-4729-5176.description:
Cast Myr Enforcer by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Myr Enforcer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1183-2249-4659.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2249-4659.description:
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan ironworks by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pentavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

225-4826-4967.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Archelos is untapped.
225-4826-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1870-4153-4873.notablePrerequisites: Eternity Vessel and Darksteel Reactor have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4153-4873.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Eternity Vessel to Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

440-1742-2428.notablePrerequisites: A way to draw a card.
440-1742-2428.description:
Draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, gaining a life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers.
Discard a card to add {B}.
Allow the Well of Lost Dreams trigger to resolve, paying {1}.
Repeat.

1661-1976-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
